# Copilot instructions

This repository follows **AGENTS.md** in the repository root. Read it before generating code.

Key rules: React Native + TypeScript (strict), offline-first with no backend, ViroReact + ARCore
for AR, SQLite for local data, all styling from `src/theme/tokens.ts` (generated from
`docs/01-design-tokens.md`), all copy verbatim from `docs/02-screens.md` and
`data/content.json`, and nothing in `design/` is production code.
